submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I focused on the low-Ca, Cu-rich edge. Copper vanadates are the photoactive phases here and Ca is expected to be inert. I sampled Cu:V ratios near Cu3V2O8 and Cu2V2O7. Index 106 (Ca0.20 Cu0.46 V0.34, Cu:V ~1.34) gave the highest EQE (0.274%). It beat both the more Cu-rich index 134 (0.166%) and the more V-rich index 89 (0.213%), which points to a local optimum near Cu:V ~1.3–1.5.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.166%. Too Cu-rich (Cu:V ~2.2), likely excess CuO.
Measured EQE 0.213%. At Cu:V ~1 the EQE is lower than at index 106.
Not measured. Low Cu content makes these compositions unlikely to hold an active copper vanadate phase that absorbs at 2.4 eV.
